targets.review_note: The text fully specifies labelled T/D connected pieces, forbidden 2x2 same-colour squares and size imbalance. Scan the shorter grid dimension with a connectivity frontier: signed canonical labels track each colour component. When the last frontier occurrence of a component disappears, reject if another component of that colour remains, otherwise close that colour permanently. This prevents later disconnected pieces and permits a finished piece to leave the frontier. Preserve the previous upper-cell colour to reject monochromatic 2x2 blocks. At the end each colour must have exactly one component (active or closed), so empty pieces are not counted. Count by T population using exact packed polynomial coefficients; 72-bit lanes exceed the maximum 2^64 colourings of an 8x8 board, so no carry changes coefficients. Validate by enumeration of every full colouring on small grids, including fixed labels and both connectivity tests.
